entries.text: You shall love the LORD thy God with all.thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
God is faithful to those that love Him, and keeps His covenant and mercy with them (God acknowledges those who love Him).
God loves them that love Him.
This is the love of God, that we keep His commandments.
He that loves father or mother, son or daughter more than Christ is not worthy of Christ.
A love of worldly things is evidence of not having a love of God.
All things work together for good to them who love God.
Heed the ways of the LORD your God, for He will test you as to whether or not you love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
We are to have a love of Christ (he who does not let him be accursed).
In order to love Christ one must obey His commandments.

We are not to allow anything to separate us from the love of God which is in Jesus Christ -not tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword, or principalities or powers.
Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
